groups.title: New
items: Added background SOMSAI matchmaking with penalties for declining matches.
Added download mirrors to both the client and the website as a fallback in case the primary links are down.
Added Friends tab on web.
Added player-selectable EZ, HD and HR combinations to SOMSAI FreeMod and tiebreaker rounds.
Added an option to randomize skin on every map start.
Added private custom matches to SOMSAI.
Added an option to ignore recommended difficulty in Song Select.
Added an Easter egg to very low-ranked SOMSAI lobbies.
Added mandatory switcher version checks and safer client startup.

groups.title: Fixes
items: Map difficulty in Multiplayer now dynamically recalculates stats based on the local mod set.
Fixed an issue where a map was unnecessarily downloaded when entering the SOMSAI lobby.

groups.title: Changes
items: Reworked SOMSAI AI bots with rank-scaled skill, rerolled archetypes, player traits and realistic score simulation.
Replaced Ranked Play with SOMSAI entirely.
Improved the profile play history tab.
Moved recent plays to the Chronology tab; scores older than 24 hours are now automatically cleared from the tab.

groups.title: Removed
items: Removed notifications when other players add or remove you as a friend.

groups.title: New
items: Added a release history page and a changelog menu to the SOMS! website.
A fallback mechanism has been added, allowing ARCHSOM players with an MMR above 3500 to find matches in situations that were previously impossible.

groups.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Double Time BPM being multiplied twice for maps selected from the SOMSAI mappools.
Fixed unprocessed multiplayer scores being displayed as 0pp for other players.

groups.title: Website
items: The website home page now shows the latest server update instead of the Local Ranked promotion card.

groups.title: Removed
items: Removed the recent results section from the website home page.

groups.title: Release
items: Initial SOMS! beta release after the end of the alpha testing period.
